headline: Wild claim Cameron Crotty off waivers from Senators
take:
Per Daily Faceoff, the Wild have claimed defenseman Cameron Crotty off waivers from the Senators. He played three games for Ottawa this year without recording a point.

The numbers say this is a depth move, not a needle-mover. Crotty averaged just over 11 minutes a game for OTT so far this season, and at five-on-five his team had 49% of the expected goals (the quality of chances, not just the shot count) while he was on the ice. The Senators were slightly better with him off it, though three games is far too small a sample to read much into. He was drafted 82nd overall by the Coyotes in 2017, and his last AHL season, 13 points in 64 games for Tucson in 2022-23, translates to about 8 points over an NHL season by our estimate. Minnesota doesn't need much from him. The Wild sit 9-3-2 and control 59% of expected goals, and their 7.8 goals saved above expected shows how much their goaltending has helped. A third-pair option who can hold even is all they're asking for.
